question: As of November 2020, which country has topped the FIFA World Football Rankings 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Belgium**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **FIFA World Football Rankings**

 
 
• The **national teams of association football **are ranked according to the FIFA World Ranking.
 
• **FIFA, football's world governing body**, ranks the teams of its member nations according to how well they performed in their games.
 
• The teams with the** best records** are placed at the top of the list.
 
• Since the rankings' inception in December 1992, eight teams - **Argentina, Belgium, Brazil, France, Germany, Italy, the Netherlands, and Spain**—have occupied the top spot.
 
• The scoring for all full international matches that FIFA recognises is determined by a **points system**.
 
• As the top-ranked team on the planet, **Belgium continues to dominate and remains at the top of the FIFA World Football Rankings, 2020**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Numerous changes have been made to the ranking system in response to complaints that the previous methodology did not accurately reflect the relative strengths of the national teams. 
 
• The** Elo chess rating system** has been incorporated into the current ranking system as of August 16, 2018.
 
• The **FIFA/Coca-Cola World Ranking** is another name for the ranking, which is currently sponsored by Coca-Cola.
 
• **FIFA World Football Rankings 2020**
 
 
• **Brazil is ranked second**, but they have closed the gap with Belgium.
 
• After resoundingly defeating Finland 2-0 and Kazakhstan 8-0 in their most recent World Cup qualifying matches, **France has risen to third place**.
 
• **Germany **ranked at 11 positions.
